ticket.summary: Upstairs toilet has been running continuously for several days; standard rebuild proposed for Sep 1 10:30 AM slot.
mitigation_advice: Close the toilet's supply shutoff valve behind the fixture (clockwise until snug) between uses to stop water waste [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Running toilet rebuild (fill valve + flush valve/flapper), parts and labor

ticket.customer_message: Running toilet is usually a worn flapper or fill valve - not urgent but wasteful. Flat rate for a full rebuild is $189, about an hour, no after-hours fee. Proposed Tue Sep 1 at 10:30 AM (SL-0901-1030); reply to confirm or request another time. Meanwhile you can close the toilet's supply valve between uses to limit waste [PB-01].
